policies.callbacks: R17 active listeners and R15 ActionExecutionRoot only; no native event IDs
policies.capacity: One unit absorbs one raw incoming damage unit; nonnegative checked R12 integer
policies.events: BEFORE -> absorption -> AFTER -> each DEPLETED -> owned callbacks drain -> removal -> REMOVED
policies.expiry: MANUAL_REFERENCE or explicit matching actor TURN_START/TURN_END/callback countdown; current creation turn counts when a matching boundary occurs
policies.refresh: Same identity/owner/caster/source/modifier link; replace capacity and expiry in place
policies.replacement: Remove existing instance and append explicitly supplied replacement
policies.selection: Priority ascending, then serialized input order; IDs selected before BEFORE callbacks, live capacity re-read after drain
